To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Boosting Network is a new learning paradigm, where one learns a sequence of models from simple to complex; (2) we introduce a new learning method -- SplitLBI, which learns a sequence of networks by growing layers and filters; (3) the learned models can be used to solve a variety of computer vision tasks.

(i) we propose a novel learning paradigm called boosting network that starts from simple models and progressively delves into complex trained models; (ii) we develop a novel SplitLBI framework for boosting network, that is capable of simultaneously growing the number of filters and layers in a network, and (iii) we conduct comprehensive experiments to show that SplitLBI can achieve better performance than state-of-the-art methods on various tasks including image classification, semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation
we propose an algorithm for Boosting Networks by splitting the layers and filters in a network, and we evaluate our approach on CIFAR10 and CIFAR100 datasets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following three questions: 1) How to design efficient and scalable methods for Boosting Network?
the following three questions: 1) How to design a boosting network?
the following questions: 1) How to design a boosting network to learn both structures and parameters from data?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Boosting Network can learn both structures and parameters of networks from scratch with a budgeted computational cost and arbitrary classes.
the Boosting Network is a new paradigm for learning complex network structures and parameters, and it can be efficiently implemented by our SplitLBI algorithm.

we propose a novel framework for Boosting Network (BN), which is able to learn network structures and parameters simultaneously from arbitrary classes with a budgeted computational cost, by iteratively splitting and growing filters and layers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we propose to learn the Boosting Network by growing its layers and filters via SplitLBI (Split Learning by Back-Propagation with Importance), which can be viewed as a novel and unified learning framework to learn the Boosts of both the structures and the parameters in a network.

we propose a novel Boosting Network framework, which can efficiently and simultaneously search for the network structures and parameters from arbitrary classes, and can also progressively grow the structures and parameters for a given class with limited computational budget.

we propose to learn the network structures and parameters by growing filters and layers, where the network is progressively grown from a simple one to a complex one by splitting the layers or filters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Boosting Network can be learned by growing filters and layers via split-layer based iterative training.
Boosting Network is a new learning paradigm, and it is feasible to achieve Boosting Network by learning filters and layers simultaneously, and progressively.
, by learning the structures of a network, one can boost the performance of the network on target tasks.
